title: My Hobby: Public Baths
titleJp: 私[わたし]の趣味[しゅみ]は銭湯[せんとう]

sentences.jp: 私[わたし]の趣味[しゅみ]は、いろいろな町[まち]の銭湯[せんとう]に行[い]くことです。
sentences.en: My hobby is visiting public baths in all sorts of neighborhoods.

sentences.jp: 銭湯[せんとう]というのは、お金[かね]を払[はら]って入[はい]る大[おお]きなお風呂[ふろ]のことです。
sentences.en: A sentō is a large bath that you pay to use.

sentences.jp: 昔[むかし]は家[いえ]にお風呂[ふろ]がない人[ひと]が多[おお]かったので、どの町[まち]にも銭湯[せんとう]がありました。
sentences.en: In the past, many people didn't have a bath at home, so every neighborhood had a sentō.

sentences.jp: 今[いま]は数[かず]が少[すく]なくなりましたが、東京[とうきょう]にはまだたくさん残[のこ]っています。
sentences.en: There are fewer of them now, but many still remain in Tokyo.

sentences.jp: 料金[りょうきん]はそれほど高[たか]くないので、学生[がくせい]でも行[い]きやすいです。
sentences.en: The price isn't that high, so they're easy to go to even for students.

sentences.jp: 多[おお]くの銭湯[せんとう]の壁[かべ]には、富士山[ふじさん]の大[おお]きな絵[え]がかいてあります。
sentences.en: On the walls of many sentō, there's a big painting of Mt. Fuji.

sentences.jp: 初[はじ]めて行[い]ったときは、ルールがわからなくて緊張[きんちょう]しました。
sentences.en: The first time I went, I didn't know the rules and was nervous.

sentences.jp: 湯船[ゆぶね]に入[はい]る前[まえ]に体[からだ]を洗[あら]うことや、タオルをお湯[ゆ]に入[い]れないことなどを、となりのおじいさんが教[おし]えてくれました。
sentences.en: An old man next to me taught me things like washing your body before getting into the bath and not putting your towel in the water.

sentences.jp: それから、そのおじいさんとは銭湯[せんとう]で会[あ]うと、よく話[はな]すようになりました。
sentences.en: After that, whenever I met him at the sentō, we'd often chat.

sentences.jp: お風呂[ふろ]から出[で]た後[あと]に飲[の]む冷[つめ]たい牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]は、最高[さいこう]です。
sentences.en: The cold milk you drink after getting out of the bath is the best.

sentences.jp: 皆[みな]さんも、ぜひ近[ちか]くの銭湯[せんとう]に行[い]ってみてください。
sentences.en: Please try going to a sentō near you, too.

questions.q: Why was there a sentō in every neighborhood in the past?
choices: They were cheaper than a home bath
Many people had no bath at home

questions.q: Who taught the writer the rules?
choices: An old man next to the writer

questions.q: Which of these is one of the rules mentioned?
choices: Don't put your towel in the bath water
